beaches.name: Loutraki (south end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the southern end of the beach, near the Corinth Canal. A naturist directory carries a 2019 report of secluded fully nudist coves behind the Pappas Hotel and a July 2023 forum report calling the canal-end section well tolerated and widely known.

beaches.name: Zoireza
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in the right-hand cove of this remote beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from July 2019, when the right cove was fully nudist, and August 2020, when the visitors were the only ones nude among campers. Access is a steep 200 m path from the Schinos-Alkyonides road.
